tests.name: arm_gate
tests.cmd: gate not live deny; arm admit

weaknesses.title: CLONEOBJ onto existing destination hard-fails (no soft last_err)
weaknesses.detail: Second CLONEOBJ a b aborts run with empty last_err. Agents must DELETEOBJ dst first. No CLONE FORCE/overwrite.
weaknesses.repro: CLONEOBJ a b; CLONEOBJ a b → ok false halted

weaknesses.title: LET varname matching CLASS FIELD hard-fails silently after CLASS
weaknesses.detail: FIELD ver; LET ver = x aborts with empty last_err. Must use rel_ver etc. No clear error message.
weaknesses.repro: CLASS with FIELD ver; LET ver = "1" → fail

weaknesses.title: GETF/SEND still need literal idents; string-var object names fail
weaknesses.detail: CLONEOBJ/RENAMEOBJ accept string vars; GETF does not. EQS slot dispatch remains.
weaknesses.repro: LET n="blue"; GETF n ver → fail

weaknesses.title: CLONE skips init — intentional but surprising
weaknesses.detail: Copied live/weight state may not match post-init invariants unless agent resets.
weaknesses.repro: clone armed blue → canary already live:1

workarounds: Never LET field names (rel_ver not ver)
Literal idents for GETF/SEND; EQS dispatch
After CLONE, SEND set_weight/arm to re-normalize
language_gaps: CLONEOBJ soft overwrite or FORCE flag
Clear error when LET shadows FIELD
issues_faced: LET ver shadow was silent hard fail — renamed rel_ver
selftest green; no language fix this iter
